Trusty as always. Try not to lose it — crowbars don't grow on trees. Shit, even trees don't grow. Also helpful for opening crates, breaking windows, killing extra-dimensional invaders, and enduring hazardous environments.

Category: Expensive • Fabrication: DV21 - 500eb - 1 Week

Class: Iconic Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 3 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon does not halve SP like a traditional Melee Weapon. This weapon deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6) to Cover (and only Cover). Additionally, this weapon provides a +1 Complementary Bonus to any Check made to force open a door, crate, or similar lock.

Fabrication: DV21 - 500eb - 1 Week
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
